items.reasons: Block justified: held text sec. 4(b) reads 'The Commission shall terminate thirty days after submitting its report'; every clause depends on the Commission, so each first end is submission date + 30 days, and no held source records the submission date. EO 12534 sec. 3(e) (cleanup revocation of committees that 'have terminated') is only an upper bound. Producer's gap text cites '49 FR 61634'; held text is 46 FR 61633 (citation slip in gap text only, not material to the block). FETCH line 230 matches the gap.

Block justified: sec. 4(b) as amended by EO 12442 ends the Commission 30 days after transmittal of its final report; only the deadline (1984-11-30) is held, and EO 12534 sec. 3(n) is an upper bound. FETCH line 231 matches.
Block justified: sec. 4(b) ends the Commission 60 days after its final report; only the EO 12449 deadline (1984-02-01) is held; EO 12534 sec. 3(d) is an upper bound. FETCH line 232 matches.

Block justified: held sec. 4(b) ends the Task Force 'thirty days after submission of its report to the President, but in no event later than January 31, 1984'. The first end is min(report+30d, 1984-01-31) and cannot be fixed without the report date; the outer limit alone is an upper bound. FETCH line 233 matches.

Block justified: held sec. 4(b) fixes 1985-09-30 as the Task Group's own term, but the sec. 2(b) report command (due 1985-07-15) is a spent one-time command needing its actual submission date, and the establishing statute (Pub. L. 98-525 sec. 1632) is not held to exclude an earlier statutory end. FETCH lines 234-235 match.

Block justified: held sec. 4(b) reads 'terminate 30 days after submission of its report, or on September 30,1985, whichever date is earlier'; report submission date not held, so 1985-09-30 is only an upper bound; Pub. L. 98-525 sec. 1511 not held. FETCH lines 236-237 match.

Block justified: EO 12496 sec. 6 ('Executive Order No. 12456 ... as amended, is superseded') has no own effective-date wording, and sec. 5 makes the new rates effective 'on the first day of the first applicable pay period beginning on or after January 1,1985', which cannot be reduced to a calendar date from held sources. FETCH line 238 matches.
